name: Block Tower
description: A human-scale tower of lacquered wooden building blocks in primary colours.
lighting: Soft top light, crisp contact shadows, glossy lacquer highlights
subject: either
prompt: A tower of giant lacquered wooden building blocks rises from a pale maple floor against a warm white wall, arches, cylinders, cubes and triangles in primary red, cobalt blue, sunflower yellow and bare beech, stacked from knee to head height the way a child would build it but at human scale. Every piece bears on the one below: the arches stand on both legs, the cylinders sit upright, and one flat plank bridges two columns to make a ledge. The wood grain shows through the gloss and runs on across each face. Soft top light gives every block a crisp contact shadow. The palette is red, cobalt, yellow and natural beech, playful, bold and architectural.
